items.exampleEn: Brown rice has more nutrients than white rice.
items.exampleZh: 糙米的營養素比白米多。

items.exampleEn: The smell of fresh bread gave me an appetite.
items.exampleZh: 新鮮麵包的香味讓我有了食慾。

items.exampleEn: These green apples are too sour to eat.
items.exampleZh: 這些青蘋果太酸了，沒辦法吃。

items.exampleEn: We picked strawberries on a farm last spring.
items.exampleZh: 去年春天我們在農場摘草莓。

items.exampleEn: We had lamb with potatoes for Sunday lunch.
items.exampleZh: 星期天午餐我們吃了羊肉配馬鈴薯。

items.exampleEn: Pepper is the most common spice in our kitchen.
items.exampleZh: 胡椒是我們廚房裡最常用的香料。

items.exampleEn: My grandmother cooked a feast for the whole family.
items.exampleZh: 奶奶為全家人煮了一桌大餐。

items.exampleEn: These bananas are not ripe yet; they are still green.
items.exampleZh: 這些香蕉還沒熟，還是綠的。

items.sentenceEn: The soup was a bit sour, so I added some sugar.
items.sentenceZh: 這湯有點酸，所以我加了一些糖。

items.audioEn: I haven't had much appetite since I caught a cold. I'll just have some soup tonight.
items.audioZh: 我感冒以後就沒什麼胃口，今晚只要喝點湯就好。

items.sentenceEn: Ripe fruit usually has a sweet smell.
items.sentenceZh: 成熟的水果通常有甜甜的香味。

items.sentenceEn: This shop sells spices from all over the world.
items.sentenceZh: 這家店賣來自世界各地的香料。

items.stemEn: Pick the tomatoes when they are red and ____.
Plants get ____ from the ground and water.
items.stemZh: 植物從土地和水中獲得養分。

items.passageEn: Every June, our town holds a strawberry feast in the park. Volunteers set up long tables, and local farmers bring baskets of ripe strawberries. A cook from a nearby hotel grills lamb with special spices. Most of the fruit is sweet, but some is a little sour. People arrive with big appetites and stay until dark. It is the busiest day of the year.
items.passageZh: 每年六月，我們鎮上會在公園舉辦草莓盛宴。志工們擺好長桌，當地農夫帶來一籃籃成熟的草莓。附近一家飯店的廚師用特別的香料烤羊肉。大部分的草莓是甜的，但也有一些有點酸。大家帶著好胃口來，一直待到天黑。這是一年中最忙碌的一天。

questions.questionZh: 大部分的草莓吃起來怎麼樣？

items.promptZh: 運動之後我的胃口很好。
referenceEn: I have a good appetite after exercise.
After exercising, my appetite is very good.
rubricZh: 「胃口很好」可寫，例如 have a good／big appetite、my appetite is good 等
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）

items.promptZh: 這條河把養分帶給沿岸的農田。
referenceEn: The river brings nutrients to the fields along its banks.
This river carries nutrients to the fields beside it.
rubricZh: 用 nutrient 的複數表示「養分」（例如 brings nutrients to…）
「沿岸的農田」可寫，例如 the fields along its banks、the fields beside it 等
